inputs.text: The R20.56 million figure is serious, but this is still an allegation—not proof of wrongdoing by Terry Pheto. The briefing to Parliament’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026, should prompt scrutiny of the systems that oversee National Lotteries Commission funding, not just a rush to make one public figure the whole story. Public funds need transparent oversight and accountability, especially when communities are meant to benefit. The SIU probe should establish what happened and who was responsible.
